summary.intent: Fix a CSS layout bug causing bin view column headers to stack vertically, then reduce staging hosting costs by switching from Phala Cloud TEE worker to a locally-hosted simulator.
summary.outcome: Both issues were resolved: PR #471 fixes the bin header layout and PR #472 wires up a local TEE worker for staging. A follow-up Copilot review comment about missing CIPHERBOX_ENVIRONMENT=staging was also addressed in the same PR.

repo: BinBrowser header was using both `file-list-header` (3-column grid, globally imported via App.css) and `bin-list-header` (5-column grid, component-imported). Equal CSS specificity meant Vite load order determined which grid won, causing the stacking bug.
Staging API is at https://api-staging.cipherbox.cc; dev server can be targeted at it via VITE_API env var.

Phala CVM derives keys via hardware-backed dstack SDK. Switching to simulator mode uses HKDF from a fixed seed — different epoch keys, so existing IPNS keys encrypted against the Phala public key become unreadable. Acceptable for staging but must be noted.
The tee-worker Dockerfile sets NODE_ENV=production, which causes the worker to reject simulator mode at startup unless CIPHERBOX_ENVIRONMENT=staging is also set in the compose environment.
`gh` CLI commands require `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN` to work in this repo's shell environment — a recurring issue.

code.finding: Header element carried both `file-list-header` and `bin-list-header` classes. Removing `file-list-header` fixes the grid-template-columns conflict since bin-list-header already defines all necessary base styles.
Defines a 3-column grid `1fr 120px 180px` on `.file-list-header` — the conflicting rule.
Added tee-worker service in simulator mode on internal network, and added CIPHERBOX_ENVIRONMENT=staging to its environment to prevent startup rejection.
Removed deploy-tee-phala job and updated TEE_WORKER_URL to point at http://tee-worker:3001 (local Docker service).

workflow: Always use `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh ...` when running gh CLI commands in this environment to avoid auth failures.
Copilot review comments on staging infra PRs may catch environment-variable gaps that aren't obvious from the Dockerfile alone — worth reading before merging.

friction: GitHub CLI repeatedly fails without `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN` — user had to correct this again and request a memory be saved despite it being a known recurring issue.
CSS specificity conflict was subtle: both rules were single-class selectors so specificity alone gave no hint; root cause required tracing Vite's CSS import/load order.
open_items: Remove PHALA_CLOUD_API_KEY and PHALA_TEE_WORKER_URL from GitHub staging environment secrets/vars after PR #472 merges — they are no longer needed.
Staging users will need to re-register after the TEE worker switch due to epoch key change (simulator HKDF seed differs from Phala hardware key).
PRs #471 and #472 are open and awaiting merge.
